findings.description: Enumerated all 48 person cards on the single people page (9 in Department Leadership and Advisors, 39 in Faculty); 45 distinct people. Every card name matches a brief.people entry and no brief person is missing from the page. No omissions.
Page contains no incoming, courtesy, joint/secondary, affiliate or below-the-line designation and no start dates, so effective_from_json is null for all records and no incoming subtotal arises.

Membership convention used: ece for included professors; cs_only only for a CS professor whose sole EE/ECE appointment is excluded (Richmond); outside_ece for all other excluded people. Counts are not affected by this convention.

Profile checks: the optional campus directory entries were fetched for Rolandi and Richmond only. Other people were decided from the department page, which was enough under the policy; no source failures occurred.

Endowed-chair-only title resolved as regular/ece/current via the campus directory (Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Regular Faculty). The directory copy is dated (2018 footer), so the rank is a corroborated but older official statement; no conflicting current statement found.

Dual CSE/ECE listing: primary CS professorship, ECE appointment only as Assistant Adjunct Professor. Adjunct is excluded, so excluded/adjunct with cs_only membership. Borderline only in that the ECE listing is an official designation, but its category is excluded by policy.
Dual listing (Undergraduate Director and Professor) consolidated to one person; included as regular/ece/current once.
Dual listing (Graduate Director and Associate Professor) consolidated to one person; included as regular/ece/current once.
Distinguished Professor with a named endowed chair is a professorial rank; included as regular/ece/current.
Associate Teaching Professor is teaching under policy; excluded.
Assistant Specialist is an academic-professional title; excluded.
Generic 'Adjunct Faculty' title has no rank; treated as adjunct and excluded. No other ECE designation is shown on the page.
